usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog, and DocsBot receives a source to train from through “Create Web Source” after “New Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Web Source” in DocsBot
bestTemplate.why: A new product means a new page, and the action adds it as a source your bot can learn.

watchOut: “Create Web Source” adds a training source, so pair it with “New Product”, not “Order Line Items Are Edited”.
